name: Gods Love For You
overview: Scripture reveals God's love as compassionate, gracious, and enduring, demonstrated through His mercy that lasts forever and His everlasting love that draws believers to Him (Psalms 86:15; Psalms 136:26; Jeremiah 31:3). This love is not distant but active and personal, as God rejoices over His people with singing and offers salvation (Zephaniah 3:17). The ultimate expression of God's love is seen in the giving of His only begotten Son, offering eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16), and exemplified by the sacrificial love of laying down one's life for friends (John 15:13).
